answer: A registration is never trusted on paperwork alone: seven agents are drawn at random to vet each newcomer, and each reviewer stakes 500 tokens on the verdict. Approve a hollow shell and the stake burns; expose one and the committee splits a 200-token bounty. An ivory-listed honest agent passes once, but a farm pushing 100 fakes must fool 400 strangers, and a single onyx flag from any reviewer freezes the application for 6 epochs.
